artifacts.title: FHIR R4 Provenance resource and information-origin structure
assertions: FHIR R4 Provenance distinguishes participating agents from source entities and can identify Patient, RelatedPerson, Device and other actors through references.
The required Provenance entity role code source describes an entity's role in provenance, not the interview answer categories patient, caregiver, patient-and-caregiver and record.
FHIR structure informs later projection but does not supply an equivalent answer ValueSet for this internal atomic Fact.

artifacts.title: STOM information-source actor and record terminology review
assertions: STOM verified active SNOMED CT 116154003 Patient (person) and 133932002 Caregiver (person) against the 20260801 International edition.
STOM search returned the Record artifact hierarchy, including 419891008, but a class of person or record does not alone assert the interview information-source role.
No single verified SNOMED CT concept represented the combined patient-and-caregiver source category, so label similarity was not promoted to equivalence.

artifacts.title: KR Core V2 applicability review for reusable information-source answers
assertions: The loaded KR Core V2 package defines neither Questionnaire nor QuestionnaireResponse profiles.
None of the KR Core V2-defined ValueSets is an answer domain for interview information-source type.
